mechanism: row-to-core balance / block-cyclic row ownership for C13-C14
hypothesis: Assigning each block every blockCount-th row preserves the minimum q/q+1 row-work distribution while interleaving block-owned row streams. It may change global-memory scheduling across blocks; no performance benefit is assumed without device measurements.
change: For rowCount == 128 and rowWidth == 16384 in ProcessWideLowPrecision, distribute q+1 rows to blockIdx < rowCount % blockCount and q rows to other blocks. Map each block-local row ordinal k to global row blockIdx + k * blockCount for input loads, prefetched loads, and output stores. Other shapes retain GetBalancedRowRange. Arithmetic, tile sizes, UB buffers, and reduction logic are unchanged.

ownership_validation.command: node -e 'for (let n=1;n<=128;n++) for(let b=1;b<=n;b++){const seen=new Uint8Array(n); for(let j=0;j<b;j++){const count=Math.floor(n/b)+(j<n%b?1:0); for(let k=0;k<count;k++){const i=j+k*b;if(i>=n||seen[i])throw Error(`invalid n=${n} b=${b} row=${i}`);seen[i]=1;}} if(seen.some(x=>x!==1))throw Error(`gap n=${n} b=${b}`)} console.log("block-cyclic partition exhaustive: N=1..128, B=1..N; coverage and uniqueness PASS")'
ownership_validation.raw_output: block-cyclic partition exhaustive: N=1..128, B=1..N; coverage and uniqueness PASS
invariants: For every tested N and B, each row maps to exactly one block-local row ordinal.
The generated row indices cover [0, N) without gaps or out-of-range indices.
Per-block row counts differ by at most one.
ownership_validation.scope_note: Static partition validation only; not runtime correctness, physical-core behavior, or performance validation.

scope_check.details: For the exact C13/C14 dimensions, block ownership changes from contiguous row ranges to interleaved row ordinals while preserving the q/q+1 row-count multiset. Input, prefetch, and output use the same mapping. Each individual GM tile remains contiguous with the same tile transaction size; arithmetic, UB buffers, and reduction topology are unchanged.
